name: @intellectual-frontiers/machine-probe
description: The probe a machine runs for its fleet: the three read-only requests it answers (facts, version, one osquery SELECT), the key line that restricts a key to them, the facts as a typed observation, and the policy pack that judges an observation with its Secure Controls Framework controls.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
